verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-call API outputs in open formats: Parse returns structured JSON, and the CLI writes .parse.md files. That is only adjacent to this story. Nothing documents a way to bulk-export all account data, such as persisted results, Studio jobs or Pipeline configurations, and leave. The 24-hour Zero Data Retention policy covers deletion, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
